notes: Ember Yearly Electricity Data (CC BY 4.0), Area = World, Subcategory = Fuel. Ember's 'Solar' combines solar PV and concentrated solar power; CSP is a small share. Ember capacity follows IRENA-type statistics. Basis differs from IEA: the IEA-stated solar PV capacity for 2024 is 2,164 GW (WEO 2025) against 1,880 GW in Ember; the cause (for example DC versus AC rating) is not confirmed. Grading must compare like with like: prefer the IEA's own later-stated historical value (base_year rows in each edition file) or state the basis. Ember 2025 values are the latest release and may be revised. Capacity additions per year are not stored; they can be derived as year-on-year differences but are not a published figure here.
